get.summary: Lists movies, drafts included, newest first.
Returns a movie with its version.

put.summary: Replaces a movie. Fails if it changed since the given version.

post.summary: Makes a movie visible to customers.

get.summary: Lists series, drafts included, newest first.
Returns a series with its seasons, episodes and version.

put.summary: Replaces a series. Fails if it changed since the given version.

post.summary: Makes a series visible to customers.

delete.summary: Removes a season without published episodes.

post.summary: Adds an episode, hidden until published.

get.summary: Lists genres with how much they are used.

Lists the genres that have published content.
Returns someone credited on published content.

post.summary: Starts an upload and returns the address to PUT the file to.

put.summary: Checks an uploaded file and puts it to use, replacing what was there.
